changes.before: Device tests before the release approval (spec §11, §16)

changes.impact: P0 gate passes; device performance stays open in P5

changes.before: Checks on the owner's phone (HDR/Dolby Vision, look and feel, gesture feel, his sources and accounts, downloads and notifications on his phone, real performance, Android 17) were part of the requirements a phase and the release waited for (NVP15-CHG-0003: tested on the final release).
changes.after: Every requirement has a release class. PRE-RELEASE REQUIRED: everything provable without the owner (full audit, fixes and polish, unit/integration/concurrency/emulator tests, performance against Build 14 in the available environments, security, data and storage, upgrade from Builds 12, 13 and 14 with the real key and representative data, identity, PortKit, CI, APK and reports). POST-RELEASE VALIDATION: the owner's personal checks, kept as NOT TESTED / NEEDS PHYSICAL DEVICE in PRV-01..07 (P9) and P8-06; mixed requirements keep their ids and evidence and name their deferred part (post_release). BLOCKED: a real engineering obstacle. A phase gate passes when its pre-release requirements hold; data, signing and upgrade requirements can never be post-release (the gate refuses it).
changes.reason: Owner: development, release preparation and phase closing must not wait for his personal testing; critical engineering tests are never deferred.
changes.impact: Device-only findings surface after installation; nothing deferred is marked PASS, VERIFIED or ACCEPTED; Build 16 stays the upstream-sync plan; signing and publishing still need the owner's separate approvals.

changes.before: The complete Build 15 work after custom-15 had no name.
changes.after: It is published as Build 16 (tag custom-16, build number 16), which the in-app updater of Build 15 offers (it reads whole numbers only). The upstream-sync plan, earlier called 'Build 16', moves to the build after it. release-names.json can show another name for a build; none is set. Build 15's unfinished work is completed in this build, as the owner directed (not moved to the sync plan).
changes.reason: Owner first chose 15.5, then, told that a tag custom-15.5 would never be offered by Build 15's updater, named it 16.
changes.impact: Release page, notes, app and APK names all say 16.

changes.before: P1 gate awaiting the owner; P5-06 had no Build 14 value for dropped frames; P7-10 acceptance with 3 transferred features open; signing and publishing of Build 16 not yet approved; Nuvio-code findings of the logs and storage audit without a decision.
changes.after: P1 gate approved. P5-06: the absolute dropped-frame measurement of the head is the comparison, Build 14 having no dropped-frame counter (stated). P7-10: three features proven by real transfer on both targets, the other twelve classified with their reason, meets the criterion. Nuvio-code findings of the logs and storage audit stay risks with a proposed fix, not changed in Plus. Signing and publishing of Build 16 approved in advance; they run only when every PRE-RELEASE REQUIRED item holds, as two separate environment steps. Branch protection: not decided in this change.
changes.reason: Owner chose each item explicitly when asked; the quality rules of NVP15-CHG-0005 stay in force.
changes.impact: These decisions no longer block the release; a failing mandatory check still stops it.

changes.before: Owner approved the original PortKit classification of 15 features (three demonstrably transferred, twelve classified). PR #106 adds an unapproved 16th feature, safe-network-logging, so P7 approval was still pending.
changes.after: Approve the additional safe-network-logging security hardening as a MANUAL PortKit feature, with no claim of automatic portability. The sixteen-feature classification now consists of three demonstrated transfers and thirteen classified features. Preserve its security scan, the reviewed code changes and passing CI as pre-merge conditions. Owner authorizes continuing the full Build 16 work, with publishing still contingent on every mandatory pre-release gate.
changes.reason: Reduce the risk of credential-bearing addon/catalog/plugin addresses being written into logs while keeping every PortKit feature classification explicit.
changes.impact: The PortKit feature inventory increases from 15 to 16; generated matrices and security review stay in scope. The new feature cannot be treated as a proven transfer, and release-scope evidence must include the merged security fix.
changes.decision: Owner in chat, 2026-11-23 (Riyadh): approved PR #106 security fix and its manual PortKit addition, and instructed completion and publication of the project subject to release gates.
